title: 火箭实验室收购铱星通信公司挑战SpaceX垂直整合打造太空巨头
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Joining us now is Peter Beck, Rocket Labs founder and CEO, live from Auckland, New Zealand.
segments.zh: 现在连线的是火箭实验室创始人兼CEO彼得·贝克，他在新西兰奥克兰。

segments.en: Let's start there, Peter. Why buy a Redium and why now?
segments.zh: 先问这个：为什么收购铱星，为什么是现在？

segments.en: Yeah, it's great to talk to you. But look, I think it's become pretty obvious, and we've talked about it for quite some time, that the really large space companies of the future are going to be
segments.zh: 很高兴和你聊。但我觉得很明显，我们讨论了很久，未来的大型太空公司会变得模糊，甚至难以定义什么是太空公司。

segments.en: a little bit blurry about what a space company even is. And you know, Rocket Lab today, we're the second most frequently launched rocket, and we have a large spacecraft business
segments.zh: 火箭实验室现在是发射频率第二高的火箭，还有大型航天器业务和零部件业务，但第三块业务一直是应用。

segments.en: and components business, but really the third leg of the store was always an application.
segments.zh: 通过合并火箭实验室和铱星，我们就能拼出完整图景。

segments.en: And by combining Rocket Lab and a Redium together, we really make that complete picture.
segments.zh: 这意味着我们是一家能自行发射的公司。看看其他拥有自己火箭和卫星的公司，这个组合非常强大。

segments.en: And what that essentially means is we are a self-launching company, and I think if you look at other companies that have their own rockets and can build their own satellites, it's a pretty powerful
segments.zh: 今早大家很快想到了更深层的垂直整合。此外还有频谱的概念，铱星拥有宝贵但有限的频谱资源。

segments.en: combination. You know, very early this morning people got very quickly to this deeper level of vertical integration. The basics of it, there's also the idea of spectrum, right? So Redium has
segments.zh: 你能量化一下吗？你们获得了多少频谱，以及如何利用它来为火箭实验室创造优势？

segments.en: valuable but a limited source of spectrum. Can you just quantify that for us? How much spectrum you get access to, and kind of like how you leverage that to Rocket Lab's advantage?
segments.zh: 你说得对。你可以拥有所有航天器、火箭和机库，但如果没有频谱来实际使用它们，尤其是

segments.en: Yeah, look, you're exactly right. I mean, you can have all the spacecraft and all the rockets and the hangers you want, but if you don't have the spectrum to actually utilize them, especially
segments.zh: 没错，你说得对。你可以拥有所有想要的航天器和火箭，但如果没有频谱来实际使用它们，尤其是

segments.en: for communications, then it's all for nothing. And the very unique thing about a Redium spectrum, it's Alban spectrum. So, you know, Alban is particularly effective in those very difficult and harsh
segments.zh: 如果通信不行，那就全白费了。铱星频谱的独特之处在于它是L波段频谱，在那些非常困难和恶劣的环境中特别有效。
